arms.dsrl: DSRL (Wagenmaker et al., CoRL 2025): the one-demo LoRA (r3_lora) switched on and frozen; a SAC agent chooses each chunk's initial noise (10 x 32, tanh-bounded at 2) from frozen ResNet-18 features + state; 100 practice episodes per task on init states 0-29 (10 warm-up with Gaussian noise, then 10 updates per chunk), sparse success reward; scored with the deterministic actor (lifelong_ood/policy/dsrl.py; arms dsrl_train, dsrl)
arms.er: experience replay / multi-task (continual-learning results for VLAs, arXiv 2603.03818): ONE rank-16 LoRA trained on all 21 demos, batches balanced across tasks, 3,000 steps (experiments/b_er.py; arm lora@er)
arms.strap: STRAP (Memmel et al., ICLR 2025): rank-16 LoRA on the demo + K = 100 sub-trajectories retrieved from pi0.5's 40 training tasks by subsequence DTW over DINOv2-B agent-view features (segments where the end-effector nearly stops, >= 20 steps), all frames under the target instruction, 2,000 steps (experiments/b_strap.py; arm lora@strap)

hypotheses.descriptive: each baseline vs the one-demo LoRA (252) and LoRA + failure negatives (302); storage; practice episodes (DSRL 100 per task, ours 0); DSRL's practice success curve
hypotheses.test: exact two-sided sign test on discordant pairs, Holm over B1-B3; direction reported; the paired difference with the two-level bootstrap interval

metrics.ours: phasebind2_rjpred_pca512_rj: the one demo's bindings, rendered-scene reader head (7 KB), no simulator state at test, no practice -- the configuration of the storage claim; existing episodes (m3_final, seed 0)
metrics.tasks: the 21 held-out tasks; init states 30-49, SERVE_SEED 0; 420 episodes per arm, paired by init state
metrics.why: the user asked for recent state-of-the-art baselines (2025-26); the existing suite (LoRA variants, full fine-tuning, VINN, DemoDiffusion, replay, DiffusionNFT-style LoRA with failure negatives) predates the families below
metrics.written_before: any scoring rollout (states 30-49) of strap, dsrl or er; only a 12-episode DSRL smoke run on practice states (experiment dsrl_smoke) preceded it
